newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina Q1 gains from Interstate.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina Q1 gains from Interstate.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co, which reported a seven percent increase in its fiscal 1997 first quarter sales and earnings, said Thursday the results benefited in part from its 45 percent stake in Interstate Bakeries Corp.

Earlier today, Ralston reported earnings for its fiscal first quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose to $137.4 million or $1.32 a share from $128.5 million or $1.23 in the same period last year. First quarter sales increased to $1.76 billion from $1.64 billion a year ago.
Operating profit from Ralston's pet products fell in the quarter as higher pet food volume and pricing were more than offset by higher costs for pet food ingredients and promotion.

Operating profit for its battery products, including its Eveready brand, declined slightly in the quarter. Strong volume in the Asia Pacific region and improved results in South and Central America were offset by lower worldwide rechargeable sales and continued declines in Europe.
